function.name: search_images
function.description: Searches the web for photos, images, diagrams, GIFs, and visual illustrations. Call this tool when the user needs visual examples, illustrations for course materials or announcements, diagrams, or references.

query.description: Image search query (e.g. 'crow bird photo', 'sorting algorithm visualization diagram', 'ancient rome forum illustration').

max_results.description: Number of images to return. Default is 3.
